Sasha: Heads up — CI microbench on PR landed by @jamal shows a weird 45% tail increase on kv-batched path.
Devin: link? :eyes:
Sasha: CI-Bot reported: https://ci.internal/reports/8065432100 — microbench 'kv_batch_hotpath' threshold diff +0.62ms (baseline 1.37 -> 1.99)
Maria: Oof. Is this the kernel-selector change from yesterday (merge 1a2b3c)?
Jamal: that PR touched the batching heuristic and added the 'early_spin' fastpath in kernel selection.
Sasha: I pulled a flamegraph from the failing run, looks like a new hot region in nv_ext::copy_with_prefetch — not typical for kv hits.
Devin: can you paste the flamegraph snippet?
Sasha: ```
# flamegraph top
nv_ext::copy_with_prefetch 38%
kernel_selector::choose_fastpath 14%
kv_cache::read 8%
batcher::coalesce_wait 6%
other 34%
```
Maria: Interesting — copy_with_prefetch up 10x vs baseline. Could be a pad/stride change after the early_spin path causes more memcpy-like work.
Jamal: I can revert the early_spin commit locally and run microbench to confirm.
CI-Bot: @Sasha @Jamal Failed job: eng-runtime/microbench/kv_batch_hotpath (PR #2145) — details: https://ci.internal/build/2145
Devin: Quick bisect plan: revert the kernel selector tweak first (cheap), then if still bad, revert the batching coalescer changes.
Sasha: Agreed. Jamal, can you run a quick local comparison with and without selector tweak? If it's selector we can roll back before a wide rollout.
Jamal: Running now. Running `cargo bench kv_batch_hotpath --bench` with perf record.
Jamal: Local results: baseline checkout -> 1.36ms, with selector tweak -> 1.98ms. Reverted -> 1.35ms. Reproducible.
Maria: That pins it. Do we know why selector would call nv_ext copy more? Maybe it forces a path that materializes token KV differently.
Devin: Hypothesis: selector's heuristic changed alignment for kv blocks causing non-coalesced GPU memcpy. Need a short repro trace.
Sasha: I captured a small perf script trace showing the warmup sequence. Attaching inline timings:
Sasha: ```
warmup seq: 0-32: choose_fastpath -> prefetch -> copy_with_prefetch (heavy)
baseline seq: choose_slowpath -> kv_cache::read (lighter)
```
Devin: If fastpath triggers on seq_len < 64 now (previously <32), that would explain it.
Jamal: Confirmed in code: condition changed to <=64 in selector. I'll open PR to tighten to <=32 and add a unit test against nv memcpy cost.
Maria: Good. Also add a microbench that asserts no >10% regression on kv_batch_hotpath in CI (catch early).
Sasha: For rollout: revert selector in release branch and cherry-pick the tightened condition once green. Keep batching changes.
Devin: I'll schedule the revert now if Jamal's fix isn't merged in 30m. Ping in this thread when PR is up.
Jamal: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/eng-runtime/patches/2147 — tests running.
CI-Bot: Build started for PR #2147.
Sasha: Thanks. Adding an issue to track root cause analysis and follow-up profiling: ENG-RUNTIME-1229.
Maria: :thumbsup: Good triage. Keep the flamegraph and perf records in the ticket.
Devin: I'll monitor CI and start the revert if no fix by +30m.
Sasha: Closing loop here — we'll avoid a rollout until we confirm fix or revert.
